_meta.note: Invented architecture office and project shelf. No real firm, person, address or parcel. Folder paths are the labels: a document's label is the folder a careful office would file it in, or "" when no folder of the shelf fits.
_meta.ambiguous: A document a second folder of the shelf could take. Its label is the one the office would choose; the flag marks the document as a judgement call, not a wrong label.
_meta.themes: Only the no-fit documents carry a theme: the group a person would give them, used to judge the new-folder grouping.
